title: eludite.solution.open input
description: Open a solution (File > Open > Project/Solution, Ctrl+Shift+O). Starts eludite-host if it is not running and loads the solution in it. Returns once the request is handed to the host; loading, the Solution Explorer tree and diagnostics stream in afterwards (see eludite/solution/status in host-rpc.md). Opening a solution closes the one that is open. The UI shows a file dialog first and passes the chosen path.

path.description: Absolute path of a .sln, .slnx, .csproj or .vbproj file.
